run_pipeline_init: run the Pipeline class initializer to create an AppleScript Pipeline instance
run_on_startup: run the on_startup lifecycle hook to print startup logging for the AppleScript Pipeline
run_on_shutdown: run the on_shutdown lifecycle hook to print shutdown logging for the AppleScript Pipeline
run_pipe_volume_control: run the pipe method to set system volume via osascript using a 'volume 50' command
run_pipe_chat_completion: run the pipe method to send a user message to Ollama for chat completion with streaming
